title: openai-image-gen/prompt-generator output
description: Contract for the JSON envelope the prompt-generator agent must emit. The framework's event-chain wakes the sibling image-generator runtime when `events[0].topic === 'openai-image.generate.requested'` and `events[0].data.prompt` is non-empty. When the LLM drops the events array (or drops `data.prompt`), the image-generator never fires and the gallery silently shows nothing — this schema documents the required shape so plugin authors can wire structured-output enforcement once the executor surfaces `output.schema` to provider request bodies.

prompt.description: Final image prompt — the same string that appears in events[0].data.prompt.

promptMode.description: Output style. text=natural-language prompt; image-json=structured JSON-as-string.

composition.description: Optional. Picture composition mode. single-scene=one moment as a single frame; comic-strip=one comic page rendered as a single image with multiple sequential panels along a timeline.

events.description: Must contain exactly one event with topic 'openai-image.generate.requested' and a non-empty data.prompt — that wakes the image-generator follower.
